title: Can I Build an AI Agent Without Knowing How to Code?

facts.fact: The article was published on August 11, 2025.
The article's step-by-step no-code workflow lists six numbered steps.
facts.quote: 6. **Define output** — chat window, email, API call

facts.fact: The article defines an AI agent as a program that understands a request, reasons about it using an LLM, performs an action, and then responds or moves to the next step.

facts.fact: The article uses GPT-4 as its example LLM for the reasoning step of an AI agent.

facts.fact: The article names FlowiseAI and Langflow as example visual AI builders for creating agents without code.
